note: The database fields every reader fills from a certificate: one row per CRM in a site's standards table, holding the expected value and 1SD that the QAQC charts use for each lab method the site runs.

fields.cu_4a_pct: Copper by four-acid (near-total) digestion: certified value, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_4a_sd_pct: Copper by four-acid digestion: one standard deviation (1SD) of the certified value, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_ar_pct: Copper by aqua regia digestion: certified value, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_ar_sd_pct: Copper by aqua regia digestion: 1SD, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_h2so4_pct: Acid-soluble copper by sulphuric acid (H2SO4) leach: certified value, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_h2so4_sd_pct: Acid-soluble copper by sulphuric acid leach: 1SD, in wt.% Cu.
fields.cu_cn_pct: Cyanide-soluble copper by cyanide (NaCN) leach: certified value, in wt.% Cu.
fields.au_fa_ppm: Gold by lead-collection fire assay (any finish): certified value, in ppm (g/t) Au.
fields.au_fa_sd_ppm: Gold by fire assay: 1SD, in ppm (g/t) Au.
fields.au_ar_ppm: Gold by aqua regia digestion: certified value, in ppm (g/t) Au.
fields.au_ar_sd_ppm: Gold by aqua regia digestion: 1SD, in ppm (g/t) Au.

rules: Certified values only. A value the certificate gives as indicative, provisional, informational or uncertified is left empty (null).
A field whose method the certificate does not report is left empty (null). Never fill a field from a different method.
Convert to the field's unit: 1 wt.% = 10,000 ppm; 1 ppm = 1,000 ppb = 1 g/t.
The 1SD fields take one standard deviation. If the certificate gives 2SD, halve it; never use a confidence or tolerance interval.
